#!/bin/bash
# Runs once, as root, before the agent starts: Harbor's [environment.healthcheck] unpacks this folder into
# /var/lib/mimo and runs it. Generated by mimo_harbor; see its README for how each step maps to Xiaomi's harness.
M=/var/lib/mimo
[ -f "$M/ready" ] && exit 0
chmod 700 "$M"
fail() { echo "setup: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# the answer-leak blocklist (mimoagent), applied to /etc/hosts by the agent right after it installs
write_blocklist() { cp "$M/files/blocklist" "$M/blocklist"; }

# General (simulated workplace): verl general_agent + mimoagent's sidecar, as the explorer runs it (domains.py General).
# The workplace files come from the benchmark at a pinned revision, each checked against its hash; the systems then
# start on 127.0.0.1 and the agent works through their MCP servers.
python3 "$M/files/fetch.py" "$M/files/fetch.json" || fail "could not fetch the workplace files"
# the sidecar needs a venv with mcp<2 (the image's own python has mcp 2.x, which renamed FastMCP)
if [ ! -x /opt/openai-agents-venv/bin/python ]; then
  python3 -m venv /opt/openai-agents-venv && /opt/openai-agents-venv/bin/pip install -q 'mcp==1.26.0' \
    || fail "could not prepare the MCP sidecar"
fi
timeout 300 sh -c 'python3 /installed-agent/sidecar_entrypoint.py --start-and-detach' > "$M/systems.log" 2>&1 || { tail -c 1500 "$M/systems.log" >&2; fail "the systems did not start"; }
for p in 39101 39102 39103 39104 39105 39106 39107; do
  for i in $(seq 60); do (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p) 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
  (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$p) 2>/dev/null || fail "system on port $p did not come up"
done
# Upstream these systems run in a separate sidecar pod. Here they share the container, so the agent is an
# unprivileged user and the systems' data and code are root-only: MCP is the way in.
id -u agent >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -u 500 -m -s /bin/bash agent
chown -R agent:agent /work/workspace
chmod 700 /work/system /work/tools /installed-agent /work/_setup 2>/dev/null
if runuser -u agent -- ls /work/system >/dev/null 2>&1; then fail "could not isolate the systems' data from the agent"; fi
echo agent > "$M/agent_user"
chmod 777 /logs/agent /logs/artifacts 2>/dev/null || true
write_blocklist

# general-pinned-backup@1: capture a consistent pre-agent system baseline.
python3 - <<'PBB_PY' || fail "general-pinned-backup@1 cannot snapshot system databases"
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
dbs = sorted(Path("/work/system").glob("*/state.db"))
if not dbs:
    raise RuntimeError("no system databases to snapshot")
for db in dbs:
    target = db.with_name("state.db.pinned_backup")
    target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    with sqlite3.connect(db.as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True) as source:
        with sqlite3.connect(target) as snapshot:
            source.backup(snapshot)
PBB_PY
touch "$M/ready"
echo "setup done"

schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/s3k_0102_accounting_audit_tax_en_t3_rl_004"
description = "TrueBlue, Inc.'s quarter-end cash application review has one unresolved duplicate-receipt cluster in Bank of America…"
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "general"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Accounting, audit & tax"
difficulty = "Tier 3"
domain = "general"
keywords = ["general", "Accounting, audit & tax", "Simulated workplace", "Tier 3", "English"]
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "s3k_0102_accounting_audit_tax_en_t3_rl_004"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
systems = 7
title = "TrueBlue, Inc.'s quarter-end cash application review has one unresolved duplicate-receipt cluster in Bank of America…"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 3600.0
user = "agent"

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 1200.0
user = "root"

[verifier.env]
GA_JUDGE_API = "chat"
GA_JUDGE_KEY = "${HF_TOKEN}"
GA_JUDGE_MODEL = "${MIMO_TEXT_JUDGE:-thinkingmachines/Inkling}"
GA_JUDGE_URL = "${MIMO_JUDGE_URL:-https://router.huggingface.co/v1}"
VERIFY_AGENT_JUDGE = "1"
VERIFY_DETERMINISTIC = "1"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:7b59eff30fb4cef86cc6a4e1c278b119c06c7167807ba30983f0346bc2b5d02e"
workdir = "/work/workspace"
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 8192
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "blackline_reconciliation"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39101/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "bofa_cashpro"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39102/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "highradius_collections"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39103/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "oracle_fusion_ar"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39104/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "servicenow_finops"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39105/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "snowflake_finance"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39106/mcp"

[[environment.mcp_servers]]
name = "workiva_evidence"
transport = "streamable-http"
url = "http://127.0.0.1:39107/mcp"

rationale: Snapshot every system state.db to state.db.pinned_backup at the end of setup so history checks read a real agent-start baseline instead of an empty auto-created database. Fail setup if any snapshot is missing; grading is unchanged.
